brazil: Five-time men's champions, home of Pelé
uruguay: Hosted and won the very first men's tournament in 1930
england: Won its only men's title at home at Wembley in 1966
sweden: Hosted the 1958 men's tournament and reached the final
mexico: The first country to host the men's tournament twice (1970, 1986)
united-states: Hosted the 1994 men's event and has won the women's title four times
south-korea: Co-hosted the 2002 men's tournament with an island neighbour
japan: Women's champions in 2011; co-hosted the 2002 men's tournament
south-africa: Hosted the first men's tournament in Africa, in 2010
qatar: Hosted the 2022 men's tournament, the first in the Middle East
china: Hosted the first women's tournament in 1991, and again in 2007
new-zealand: Co-hosted the 2023 women's tournament with a larger neighbour
